# The Diets — Online Nutrition & Clinical Diet Consultations

> The Diets provides 100% online, 1-on-1 private video dietitian consultations led personally by clinical nutritionists Dt. Radha Mishra and Dt. Surbhi Kumari across India and internationally.

## Organization & Brand Identity
- **Brand Name:** The Diets
- **Tagline:** Your Health, Your Goals, Your Personalised Nutrition Journey (आहार शुद्धौ सत्त्वशुद्धिः)
- **Primary Website:** https://thedeits.vercel.app (Configurable via SITE_URL)
- **Service Model:** 100% Virtual / Online video consultations via private video + active WhatsApp follow-up support.
- **Service Area:** Pan-India (Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai, Kolkata, Pune, Tier-1 & Tier-2 cities) and Global Indian Diaspora.
- **Core Philosophy:** Kitchen-first, home-cooked Indian meals. Zero starvation, no crash dieting, no mandatory exotic ingredients, no separate cooking from family meals.
- **Direct Contact:** 
  - Phone / WhatsApp: +91 92960 47483
  - Official Email: thediets4you@gmail.com
  - Booking: /book

## Clinical Dietitians & Founders

### Dt. Radha Mishra
- **Role:** Founder | Clinical Nutritionist & Dietitian
- **Credentials:** B.Sc., M.Sc. in Clinical Nutrition, Certified Diabetes Educator (CDE), International Association of Distance-Learning Dietitians (IADWL)
- **Experience:** 5+ Years Clinical Experience
- **Clinical Specialisations:** Weight Loss & Sustainable Fat Loss, Type 1 & Type 2 Diabetes Management, Glycemic Control (HbA1c reduction), PCOS/PCOD Hormonal Care, Therapeutic Nutrition, Custom Indian Diet Frameworks.

### Dt. Surbhi Kumari
- **Role:** Co-Founder | Dietitian & Nutrition Professional
- **Credentials:** B.Sc., M.Sc. in Food and Nutrition
- **Experience:** 3+ Years Clinical Experience
- **Clinical Specialisations:** Lifestyle & Weight Management, Thyroid Health (Hypothyroidism & Hyperthyroidism), PCOS/PCOD Cycle Regularity, Gut & Digestive Comfort, Anti-inflammatory Diets.

## Core Clinical Nutrition Programs
1. **First Clarity Session (30–45 Mins):**
   - Deep-dive diagnostic video consultation exploring medical reports, digestive symptoms, work routine, kitchen logistics, and metabolic health history.
2. **Weight Loss & Lifestyle Reset (1–3 Months):**
   - Paced, sustainable calorie-smart nutrition utilizing home-cooked Indian meals (roti, dal, rice, sabzi). No starvation, steady inch-loss, and high daily energy.
3. **PCOS/PCOD Hormonal Harmony:**
   - Root-cause nutritional intervention targeting insulin resistance, ovarian function, acne, hair fall, and cycle regularity without rigid restrictions.
4. **Diabetes & Metabolic Health:**
   - Led by Certified Diabetes Educator (CDE). Clinically managed glycemic indexing, meal timing, and continuous glucose monitoring alignment to improve HbA1c.
5. **Thyroid & Gut Health:**
   - Therapeutic nutrient density targeting sluggish metabolism, bloating, acidity, and lipid imbalances.
